_: Tracker tuning. Read at startup; command-line flags override.

filter._: One Euro. min_cutoff controls jitter when the hand is still; beta controls how much the filter sharpens up when it moves. Measured at 60fps on a 0..1 signal: these give ~2.9 frames (48ms) of filter lag and keep ~9% of resting jitter. Lower min_cutoff if the dot creeps when you hold still; raise beta if it lags behind a fast sweep.

pinch._: Thumb-to-index distance divided by hand span. Closes below close_at, opens above open_at. The gap between them is the hysteresis and it is the only thing stopping a grab from being a coin flip. Never set open_at at or below close_at.
